name: US-India Trade Relations
key_benefits: Access to the US market under Most Favored Nation (MFN) tariff rates.
origin_criteria: Standard rules of origin applicable for MFN treatment.

specific_regulations.food_and_agriculture: Must be registered with the US FDA and comply with the Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA). Prior notice of imported food shipments must be submitted to the FDA.
specific_regulations.pharmaceuticals: Facilities must undergo FDA inspection and adhere to Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP). Exporting Indian pharma requires NDA/ANDA approvals.
specific_regulations.customs: All commercial shipments require filing CBP Form 3461 (Customs Release) and CBP Form 7501 (Entry Summary). US CBP MFN tariffs apply to Indian goods.
